raw_prompt: !fix the giant pig skript. get rid of the 'generic' in the command. mc 1.21 changed it to just minecraft:scale
reviewer_feedback: Updated the giant pig spawning command to use the correct Minecraft 1.21 attribute syntax for scaling.
usage_instructions: Use the command /spawnbigpig to summon a giant pig.
Requires operator permissions to execute the command.

mutations.content:
command /spawnbigpig:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        spawn a pig at player
        set {_pig} to last spawned entity
        set max health of {_pig} to 100
        heal {_pig}
        set {_uuid} to uuid of {_pig}
        execute console command "attribute %{_uuid}% minecraft:scale base set 3"
        send "&aSpawned a giant pig!" to player

traces.intent_summary: Update the giant pig script to replace the generic attribute with minecraft:scale for Minecraft 1.21 compatibility.

traces.rationale: Updated the attribute command from 'minecraft:generic.scale' to 'minecraft:scale' to comply with Minecraft 1.21 attribute changes as requested.
